canonical_project: Leading Edge Data Centres WGA1 (Wagga Wagga)
notes: LEDC WGA1 regional edge facility in Wagga Wagga (Wagga Wagga LGA, Riverina): ~0.3MW / ~2,282 sq ft colo, ISO 27001, N+1 network design; reported under construction in 2024 and operational per LEDC (LinkedIn May 2024) completing LEDC's regional NSW network.
